text_block_list.text:
At long last, the Arima Kinen has
arrived, and the
stage is set for the
ultimate sibling showdown.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Бива Хаяхидэ can't even remember the
last time
she and her sister raced each
other. While
acknowledging Narita
Brian's abilities, she
proclaims that she
will win this climactic
confrontation.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
This time, she will be the one to triumph!
The final
showdown with Нарита Брайан the
Beast begins!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
